askSiriNarEr: Ask Siri «Når er neste bønn?» in Norwegian to hear the next prayer.
theNextPrayerAnd: The next prayer and today's times on your watch, with watch face complications.
seeTheNextPrayer: See the next prayer, today's times and nearby mosques in the car.
pressAndHoldThe: Press and hold the app icon for the next prayer, Qibla and the calendar.
theNextPrayerAnd2: The next prayer and today's times on your watch, with a tile and complication.
duasForPrayerRamadan: Duas for prayer, Ramadan and Hajj, with transliteration and translation.
countDhikrAfterPrayer: Count dhikr after prayer with prayer beads.
theCalendarCanShow: The calendar can show Hijri as the main calendar, and prayer times for other places.
moreTimesOnThe: More times on the day page
seeDuhaMidnightAnd: See Duha, midnight and Tahajjud for every day.
writeToUsRight: Write to us right from the app under More. We reply in the app.
languagesBody: The app follows your phone language.
newSettingsBody: Settings are gathered in one place, with previews of notifications and widgets.
jumuahFridayBody: On Fridays the Dhuhr jamat time shows as Jumuah, also on your watch and in the car.
vippsCopy: Easier to give to your mosque
vippsCopyBody: The Vipps number is copied before Vipps opens, so you just paste it.
